kpis.description_fr: Net Bookings FY25 (commandes nettes). Indicateur leading critique : visibilité 12-18 mois sur revenue. Q4 2025 record à 13,2 Mds €.
kpis.description_en: FY25 Net Bookings. Critical leading indicator: 12-18 month revenue visibility. Q4 2025 record at €13.2bn.
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 press release table 'Net bookings FY 2024: 18,899 / FY 2025: 28,035'.

kpis.description_fr: Unités EUV livrées FY25. Monopole mondial. Inclut premiers High-NA EXE en production volume.
kpis.description_en: EUV units shipped FY25. Global monopoly. Includes first High-NA EXE in volume production.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog fin 2025. Visibilité revenu 1,2 année. Couvre EUV avec demande forte IA.
kpis.description_en: Backlog end 2025. 1.2-year revenue visibility. EUV-heavy with strong AI demand.
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 press release: '€38.8 billion'. AR2023 l.154 (€39.0bn fin 2023).

kpis.description_fr: Record FY25, +15,6% portée par demande IA et mix EUV premium. Guidance 2026: 34-39 Mds €.
kpis.description_en: FY25 record, +15.6% driven by AI demand and premium EUV mix. 2026 guidance: €34-39bn.
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 press release. AR2021/2022/2023 financial statements.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Service & upgrades FY25, +26%. Récurrent, cushion contre cyclicité. Cible 8-9 Mds€ atteinte avant 2030.
kpis.description_en: Service & upgrades revenue FY25, +26%. Recurring, cyclical buffer. €8-9bn target reached before 2030.
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 press release. AR2023 + AR2022 + AR2021.

kpis.description_fr: GM record 2025, +150bps via mix EUV premium et hausse marges service. Cible 56-60% en 2030 avec ramp High-NA.
kpis.description_en: Record GM 2025, +150bps via premium EUV mix and rising service margins. 56-60% target by 2030 with High-NA ramp.
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 press release: 'Gross margin FY24: 51.3 / FY25: 52.8'.

kpis.description_fr: Record Q4 2025 à 13,2 Mds € dont 7,4 Mds € EUV. Forte accélération versus Q4 2024 (7,1 Mds €).
kpis.description_en: Q4 2025 record at €13.2bn including €7.4bn EUV. Strong acceleration vs Q4 2024 (€7.1bn).
kpis._source_citation: Q4 FY2025 + Q4 FY2024 press releases.

kpis.description_fr: Part Chine dans CA FY25 = 9,52 Mds € sur 32,67 (29%). DUV uniquement, EUV interdit par export controls US/NL. Premier marché ASML.
kpis.description_en: China share of FY25 revenue = €9.52bn out of €32.67bn (29%). DUV only, EUV banned under US/NL export controls. ASML's #1 market.
kpis._source_citation: v2-pipeline/asml.json revenue_by_geography slices, source ASML Annual Report 2025 Note Consolidated Financial Statements.

kpis.signal: Premier High-NA EUV (EXE:5000) installe en 2024 chez client majeur. 10 ans de developpement. Prochaine generation lithographie.
kpis.description_fr: Premier systeme High-NA EUV (TWINSCAN EXE:5000) installe en 2024 chez un client majeur (Intel rapporte). 10 ans de R&D, $400+ M par tool.
kpis.description_en: First High-NA EUV system (TWINSCAN EXE:5000) installed in 2024 at major customer. 10 years of R&D, $400M+ per tool.

kpis.signal: 22.4 Mds € Chine FY24 = principale region ASML. Catch-up DUV pre-restrictions export.
kpis.description_fr: Ventes nettes Chine FY24. Plus grand marche d'ASML, principalement DUV pour fabs mature node. Restrictions export EUV.
kpis.description_en: China net sales FY24. ASML's largest geography, mainly DUV for mature node fabs. EUV export restrictions in place.

kpis.signal: 583 systemes net livres FY24. Volume eleve, mix EUV/DUV optimise pour resilience cycle.
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de systemes net livres FY24 (unites). Inclut EUV (NXE+EXE) et DUV. Indicateur volume production.
kpis.description_en: Total net systems shipped FY24 (units). Includes EUV (NXE+EXE) and DUV. Production volume metric.

kpis.signal: 4.3 Mds € R&D FY24, ~15% du CA. Investissement High-NA EUV + Hyper-NA + DUV continu.
kpis.description_fr: Depenses R&D ASML FY24. ~15% du CA, finance leadership lithographie (High-NA, Hyper-NA, DUV next gen).
kpis.description_en: ASML R&D spending FY24. ~15% of revenue, funds lithography leadership (High-NA, Hyper-NA, DUV next gen).

kpis.signal: 5 150 fournisseurs (1600 NL + 750 EMEA + 1400 NA + 1400 Asie). Supply chain mondiale ultra-complexe.
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de fournisseurs ASML. Reseau global ultra-complexe pour assembler 1 systeme EUV (~100 000 pieces).
kpis.description_en: Total ASML suppliers. Globally complex network to assemble 1 EUV system (~100,000 parts).

_notes: ASML EUV monopoly leader. Source: ASML Annual Reports 2021-2023 + Q4 FY2024 + Q4 FY2025 + Q1 2026 press releases. Verified value-by-value from local sec-data sources. 13 KPIs in main pipeline with ≥5y history for 9 KPIs.
